bio: The Broken Reach and the Voidscar are kept apart by one fortress: the Fell Barbican. Kyoze built it. Kyoze holds it. He gave up all ambition for the sake of this duty, but the act was not entirely selfless – he erased his future to be forgiven for his past, and his was a past that needed forgiving.
